text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — Monday RFC review needs a small reorder. Two presentations have a reviewer conflict and one author is IST. Can we re-sequence?
Liam: Which presentations are conflicting?
Maya: Anand's ctx-routing RFC and Sara's kv-cache deep-dive. Anand is IST and prefers morning PT slots; Sara has dentist 11:00-14:00 PT.
Anand: I can present any time before 13:00 PT on Mon. Earlier is better for me.
Sara: I can be flexible but late afternoon is easiest. If you need me earlier I can shift but prefer not before 10:30 PT.
Jess: Given impact, we should prioritize latency/regression-risk items first. Proposal: ctx-routing (Anand) -> batching (Jess) -> kv-cache (Sara).
Liam: We only have 60 minutes on the calendar. Will that order fit?
Maya: Draft agenda I sketched: 
- 5m quick updates + incident notes
- 20m ctx-routing (Anand) focused Q/A
- 20m batching (Jess) design + concerns
- 15m kv-cache (Sara) deep-dive
- 5m action items/wrap
That totals 65m — we can trim by pushing infra updates offline or shortening ctx-routing if pre-reads are good.
Liam: Can presenters add TL;DRs so we can trim live discussion? @dev-bot, nudge for pre-reads?
dev-bot: Reminder posted: https://intranet.redwood.com/rfcs/ — pre-reads requested by EOD Friday. Please add 3 bullet TL;DRs to your PR header.
Anand: Added TL;DR + small perf graph to the PR. I can commit to 15m if everyone reads the pre-read.
Sara: I'll drop a 3-bullet summary in the PR and mark availability.
Jess: If ctx-routing is trimmed to 15m we should give batching 20 and kv-cache 15 (total 55 + 5 updates = 60). I can shorten my section to 15 if needed.
Maya: OK — new order locked: ctx-routing (Anand) 15m, batching (Jess) 20m, kv-cache (Sara) 15m. Quick updates offline.
Maya: Also: need someone to take notes + capture action items. Volunteers?
Jess: I can take notes and file follow-ups.
Liam: Thanks Jess. I'll update the calendar and agenda doc.
Maya: One final ask: presenters, please add a single code snippet or command to repro perf numbers if applicable (e.g., `python bench.py --seq 2048 --warmup 50`) so reviewers can sanity-check locally.
Anand: Will add the command and sample output.
Sara: Done — added repro snippet and annotated expected CI flakiness.
Liam: Calendar updated to Mon 10:00 PT (60m). @calendarbot set meeting and attached agenda link.
calendarbot: Event created: "RFC Review — Mon" 2026-03-23 10:00 PT. Agenda: https://intranet.redwood.com/meetings/rfc-review/2026-03-23
Maya: Awesome. If anyone has hard blockers for the time change ping me here. Otherwise I’ll send final pre-read reminder Friday morning.
Liam: Noted. Thanks all.
Sara: :thumbsup:
Anand: :rocket:
Jess: See you Monday, will post notes afterwards.
